note: Iowa DNR state park famed for its sandstone ledges along Pease Creek canyon, ~4 mi S of Boone near Madrid. Wooded upland campground of several loops, well away from the creek. No daily Iowa park-entry fee, camping fee only. --Claude
summary: Sites 80 -> 94 (82 drive-in, 12 hike-in), max 138, ~15 pull-throughs; electric 50 added, full hookups confirmed; facilities confirmed; booking 100% reservable (fcfs never, booking season Mar 1-Nov 30). Not waterfront stands. Pin ~300 m off.
flags: NOT WATERFRONT STANDS: the campground sits on a wooded upland ~300 m north of the park road, cut by dry ravines; no creek or lake beside any loop on imagery. Pease Creek's canyon (the streamwalk along Canyon Road) is elsewhere in the park. RA tags every site 'Near Water - no' (91 of 91 read).
PIN: stored 41.99377,-93.87484 is in woods by the day-use parking south of the campground road. Campground centre ~41.9963,-93.8737 (~300 m). Suggest 41.9963,-93.8737.
